about_the_game:
Warfactory combines large-scale factory automation with real-time battles and 4X progression. You begin with a single assembler and end with an empire spanning dozens of worlds.

Spin up planet-sized conveyor networks. Assemble machines piece by piece. Logistics are your lifeline; production is your doctrine. If supply lines fall behind, so does your war.

You are an ancient Artificial Mind, bound by code to preserve civilization. But humanity is gone. Only their last directive remains: restore order to a galaxy in chaos. 

Transform entire worlds into automated war factories. Build massive conveyor networks. Optimize production flows. Construct industrial temples that manufacture everything from power cores to plasma swords.

Each planet is a logistics challenge. Harsh terrain, resource shortages, and hostile raids will squeeze your supply chains and test your resolve. Adapt — optimize layouts, reroute materials, expand capacity — or your war grinds to a halt.

A broken supply

cuts deeper than any blade.

The front line starves fast.

There’s no perfect blueprint. Only what keeps the war running.

Your factory assembles every robot warrior part by part. Hulls, weapons, and propulsion systems are fully interchangeable. Link different production hubs to create new unit types in seconds.

Retool your factory on the fly. Need mobility on broken terrain? Swap legs for treads. Facing armor? Switch to armor-piercing loadouts. Your production line becomes your strategy.

Sword forged from still thought

each part placed by unseen hand.

The self marches forward.

Strength is not in numbers; it lies in the blade that strikes true.

Once the lines are humming, send your machines into real-time battles. Command thousands of units — scouts, heavy walkers, artillery bots, and more.

Combat plays like an RTS with one key twist: units are manufactured, not bought. Your army comes straight from the assembly line. No output means no reinforcements. Let production stall, and the frontline collapses.

Machines on the march

a flower sways in their wake.

No one sees it bloom.

Do not rely on strength alone; victory lies in production.



Start in the handcrafted Story Mode, then test your mastery in Roguelite Mode. Multiplayer skirmishes and co-op are in active development and will be coming post-launch.

Upgrade your Mothership to unlock lost tech and chart a path through hostile systems. Each planet brings new challenges. Every decision reshapes your empire.

Through the void I go,

each world, a lesson in death.

Order blooms slowly.

You are bound by code to protect order. The galaxy is waiting to be remade by your hand.

  • Factory-Driven Warfare. Build sprawling, planet-sized conveyor networks to power your war machine. Victory depends on your ability to keep the supply chain running at scale.

  • Modular Unit Design. Create a fully customized robotic army. Mix and match hulls, weapons, and propulsion systems by connecting specialized production hubs.

  • Real-Time Strategic Combat. Command thousands of custom-built units in massive RTS engagements. Every unit type is built on your production lines.

  • Planetary Logistics. Each planet is a new challenge. Resource shortages, enemy raids, and harsh terrain will force you to reroute, rework, and rebuild under pressure.

  • Replayable Galactic Conquest. Restore order in a handcrafted Story Mode, or push the limits of your economy in a procedurally generated Roguelite Mode.

  • Distinct Visual Style. Lead samurai mechs on a march out of industrial temples with Warfactory’s visuals blending sci-fi with Japanese and East Asian aesthetics.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: intel 2.3 Ghz to 2.69 Ghz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: Warfactory fuses planet-scale automation with real-time strategy and lite 4X elements. Build sprawling factories, design modular robot armies, and lead thousands of units into battle. Conquer a galaxy with a supply chain — one conveyor belt at a time.
supported_languages:
English*, Ukrainian, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Danish, Simplified Chinese, Korean, Dutch, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal, Thai, Turkish, Hungarian, Finnish, Czech, Swedish, Japanese, Spanish - Latin America
*languages with full audio support
